newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JACKSON LEAVES EVERTON FOR NORWICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JACKSON LEAVES EVERTON FOR NORWICH.

text.p: Everton defender Matthew Jackson joined first division Norwich on Monday night in a 450,000 pounds ($642,000) deal.
Jackson, rumoured as likely to join Birmingham City, has instead opted to join a Norwich side who desperately need some defensive stability after conceding 11 goals in their last two matches.
He looks certain to go straight into the side at QPR on Boxing Day.

"He is a footballer, at 6 feet one inch (1.85 metres) he gives us that bit of height, he is mobile, can play fullback or centre half; he has played in a cup final and at 25 he is a good age," said Walker.
